finance.guide.page.1:
How do I start?

[Ledger] Book + 2 paper + ink + iron nugget. Right-click for balances. If the shortcut fails, hold it.
finance.guide.page.2:
How do I enter the market?

[Terminal] Planks + copper + glass pane + redstone. Place and right-click; no stock knowledge required.
finance.guide.page.3:
How do I store goods?

[Warehouse] Chest + iron + stone + redstone. Tier one moves at most 64 per action.
finance.guide.page.4:
How do I upgrade storage?

Sneak-right-click for requirements. Upgrade beside the block; the server consumes inventory and cash.
finance.guide.page.5:
How do I trade?

Deposit real items, then sell at a market terminal. Goods locked by orders cannot be withdrawn.
finance.guide.page.6:
How do I deliver a contract?

Accept it at a warehouse and return with real items. Rewards are escrowed; failures do not consume goods.
finance.guide.page.7:
How do I form a company?

After a contract, craft a desk. Invite members and bind storage. Roles are not shareholder votes.
finance.guide.page.8:
How do I run a factory?

[Factory] Furnace + pistons + iron + redstone. Bind company storage and wait for a natural MC day.
finance.guide.page.9:
How do I upgrade a factory?

Sneak-right-click for costs and upgrade nearby. Tiers improve throughput and upkeep, never market returns.
finance.guide.page.10:
How do I move warehouse cargo?

Use an empty crate on the destination, then use it at the source with a commodity stack in your offhand. Carry it to the target and use it again to unload.
finance.guide.page.11:
Advanced and admin

A Nether-stage securities terminal is optional. The central-bank console has no survival recipe.

How do I help a village?

Place a trade station near a village, accept food, material, or defense needs, then return with real items. Rewards are escrowed.

finance.guide.page.13:
How do surveys work?

Craft a survey board and use it some distance from a registered settlement or warehouse. The note gives only direction and estimated range; interact with the real target to receive escrow.
